title: NASA’s Simulated Mars Crew Marks One Year Inside Habitat
summary: The four crew members in NASA’s simulated Mars mission have spent the past year living and working in isolation in a confined habitat at NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston.
body: Members of NASA’s CHAPEA (Crew Health and Performance Exploration Analog) Mission 2 crew stands in their workspace after spending a year in their isolated and confined habitat at NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston. (from left: James Spicer, Matthew Montgomery, Ellen Ellis, and Ross Elder). NASA The four crew members in NASA’s simulated Mars mission have spent the past year living and working in isolation in a confined habitat at NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston. For the past 365 days, the Crew Health and Performance Exploration Analog ( CHAPEA ) Mission 2 crew members have operated as though they were on the Red Planet, growing crops, managing limited resources, navigating communication delays, and conducting suited extravehicular activities on a simulated Martian surface. Crew members include Ross Elder, mission commander; Ellen Ellis, medical officer; Matthew Montgomery, science officer; and James Spicer, flight engineer. They entered their 1,700 square foot 3D-printed habitat Oct. 19, 2025. title: Garmin Venu 3S drops back to its lowest price we’ve seen
summary: The Garmin Venu 3S falls to $319.99 on Amazon, with up to 10 days of battery life and wellness tracking.
body: The Garmin Venu 3S has dropped to $319.99 on Amazon, down from its $459.99 RRP. That’s a $140 saving and a 30% discount relative to the recommended retail price, which is a strong cut on a premium Garmin smartwatch. See the deal at Amazon
